scope: Move the manifest-bound legacy updater RAM work into a private RAM-only transaction directory, initialize protected new namespaces, restore the exact original namespace on rollback, and resume only from a bound durable receipt
invariants: No scratch or backup archive under /opt
Never borrow a live unrelated updater's locks
No deletion of unknown namespace or children
Record identities before each rename; preserve transaction evidence on interruption
Keep old legacy locks as fences until the exact old updater exits
